**Inferring writer's block**

I'm trying to figure out the concept of writer's block. If I combine main ideas like "writer" — which comes from literature and my work occupation — with notions like "block," it all starts to make sense. The idea of a "yellow cube" linked with a "shield" could symbolize the barriers writers face. These clues seem to point me toward the fundamental concept of writer's block. So, the answer is indeed writer's block!
